tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gdan sa chen po'i dbyar chos dgun chos kyi gzhi len chen po'i chos spyod sgrig rim bzhugs// oṃ swasti/ gdan sa chen po'i dbyar chos dge 'dun chos spyod sgrigs rim la/ thog mar skyabs 'gro nyer gcig bzang spyod yan lag bdun pa/ sems bskyed gdangs ma/ de nas thub bstod sems brtse ma/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi bstod pa gdangs ma/ a la la te ma/ tshangs dbang / tshangs spyod ma/ yon tan rgya mtsho ma gdangs ma/ skabs 'dir gsol ja dang po la ja mchod skal bzang ma/ chos rgyal ma gdangs ring / bar gdang / gdang thung dang bcas pa de nas sangs rgyas kun gyi ma dang / bla ma dam pa/ theg chen chos rje/ g.yag rong / kun mkhyen rnams kyi sku bstod sho lo ka re/ yon tan tshad med ma/ rab mdzes ma/ shes bya kun la ma bcu gcig gdang ring dang bcas pa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho ma/ byams pa'i dpal mnga' ma bcu gcig 'dzam gling che dgu ma yongs rdzogs/ byams pa'i mnga' bdag ma gdangs ma/ grags pas mkha' khyab ma bcu gcig legs pa'i 'byung gnas ma yongs rdzogs/ sngags 'chang bstan nyi ma gdangs ma/ de nas gong bzhugs sgar chen sku mched kyi sku bstod/ sangs rgyas kun 'dus ma bcu gcig rgyal ba gnyis pa la gdangs ma/ spyan snga rin po che dang / mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyi sku bstod/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma gdangs ma/ de nas 'jam dbyangs rigs thig ma yongs rdzogs/ ngag dbang lha yis rjes su bzung ma bcu gcig 'jam pa'i dbyangs dngos sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes sogs sho lo ka gcig de nas dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyi sogs/ bla ma sku khams bzang ba sogs/ sku bsod ri bo sogs/ de nas gsang chen ma/ skye ba kun du yang dag bla ma sogs tshig bcad rnams dang / thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mjug tu/ byang phyogs skyong ba'i sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs bkra shis mdzad rjes mang ja gnyis pa gtang ja mchod gsar pa ngo mtshar phun tshogs ma mdzad cing /

de steng gsol ba mdzad bar chos las pas bshad pa byed cing / de nas gzhis byes kyi bstan pa'i rnam gzhag pa sogs kyi pod chen drug ka la rigs lung cha snyoms nas mdzad pa'i bar la nyung ja dang mang ja gnyis rim pas btang ba'i ja mchod oṃ las ma dang / he ru ka pa ma mdzad/ der rjes bzhugs gral grol khar zhal dkar theg chen mtshams/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas sogs/ bzang spyod kyi mjug dang / bdag gi dus gsum ma yongs rdzogs/ 'gro la bde skyid ma gdangs ma smon lam dang bkra shis kyi mtha' rten dang bcas pa mdzad pa phyogs dus kun du dge legs kyis khyab par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ gdan sa chen po'i dbyar chos dgun chos kyi gzhi len chen po'i chos spyod sgrig rim/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
